# std/json
JSON encoding for AILANG
Provides ADT for JSON values and encoding function

  getNumberArrayStrict(Json, string) -> Option[list[float]]
    getNumberArrayStrict: Get number array from object (strict)

  getNumberArrayOrEmpty(Json, string) -> list[float]
    getNumberArrayOrEmpty: Get number array or [] if missing/invalid

Strings are immutable UTF-8 sequences.
